## The system, in containers

**The only authored part of this map** (`system.spec.json`): which containers to think
in, what each is for, and the document that owns it. Everything else on this page is
derived. `python3 -m tools.blueprint verify` exits 1 if any of it stops matching the
tree — a container naming a package that no longer exists, a module nobody claims, a
module two containers claim, or an owning document that is not tracked.
